tools.name: web_publishing_status
tools.title: Web Publishing status
tools.description: Return redacted nginx, cloudflared, route, and provider status.

tools.name: web_publishing_config_get
tools.title: Get Web Publishing config
tools.description: Return the saved Web Publishing config with secret fields represented by presence flags.

tools.name: web_publishing_config_validate
tools.title: Validate Web Publishing config
tools.description: Validate a draft Web Publishing route model without mutating local or Cloudflare state.

tools.name: web_publishing_config_apply
tools.title: Apply Web Publishing config
tools.description: Validate and persist Web Publishing route/config state for provider preflight and supervisor reload.

tools.name: web_publishing_cloudflare_tunnel_plan
tools.title: Plan Cloudflare tunnel changes
tools.description: Return redacted Cloudflare tunnel and DNS changes for the current or draft route model.

tools.name: web_publishing_cloudflare_tunnel_apply
tools.title: Apply Cloudflare tunnel changes
tools.description: Create or update Cloudflare tunnel ingress, with DNS record mutation only when explicitly requested.
